AI_AGENT.DESCRIPTION: Configure your AI assistant to help manage conversations

PROMPT.LABEL: System Prompt
PROMPT.PLACEHOLDER: Enter instructions for your AI assistant...
PROMPT.HELP: This prompt guides how the AI responds to conversations
PROMPT.REQUIRED_FOR_TESTING: Add a system prompt, then save your changes before testing this AI agent.

ENABLED.LABEL: Enable AI Assistant
ENABLED.HELP: When enabled, the AI will respond to conversations assigned to it

INBOXES.LABEL: Connected Inboxes
INBOXES.HELP: Select which inboxes this AI assistant can be assigned to

TOOLS.LABEL: Built-in Tools
TOOLS.HELP: Enable the allowlisted tools available to this AI agent.

HUMAN_HANDOFF.LABEL: Human handoff
HUMAN_HANDOFF.HELP: Allow the AI agent to hand conversations to a human and limit which existing labels it may apply.
HUMAN_HANDOFF.ALLOWED_LABELS_HELP: Only existing account labels can be selected. The AI can apply only this subset during handoff.

IKAS_LOOKUP_ORDER.LABEL: ikas lookup order
IKAS_LOOKUP_ORDER.HELP: Allow the AI agent to look up connected ikas order, package, payment, cargo, and tracking status from order number, phone, email, or the conversation contact.
IKAS_LOOKUP_ORDER.CONNECTED: ikas order lookup is ready for order and cargo questions.

IKAS_CATALOG_SEARCH.LABEL: ikas catalog search
IKAS_CATALOG_SEARCH.HELP: Allow the AI agent to search the connected seller catalog before answering product, stock, size, dimension, color, category, weight, volume, and organic product questions.
IKAS_CATALOG_SEARCH.READY: ikas catalog is synced and ready for catalog answers.
IKAS_CATALOG_SEARCH.UNAVAILABLE: ikas catalog search is unavailable (connection: {state}, catalog: {catalogStatus}).

USAGE_REPORT.TITLE: AI usage
USAGE_REPORT.HELP: Monthly AI conversation usage for this account.
USAGE_REPORT.EXHAUSTED_HELP: AI replies are paused until the monthly limit resets. New customer messages are routed to humans.

TEST_CONVERSATIONS.TITLE: Test Conversations
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.CLEAR_ALL_CONFIRM: Delete all test conversations? This cannot be undone.
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.EMPTY: No test conversations yet. Start a new one to test your AI agent.
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.EMPTY_CHAT: Select or create a test conversation to begin chatting
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.MESSAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: Message limit reached (200 messages max). Start a new test conversation.
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.HANDOFF_PREVIEW: This conversation would be handed off to a human agent.
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.SAVE_BEFORE_TESTING: Save your changes before testing this AI agent.
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.ENABLE_BEFORE_TESTING: Enable this AI agent and save your changes before testing.
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.ADD_PROMPT_BEFORE_TESTING: Add a system prompt and save your changes before testing this AI agent.
TEST_CONVERSATIONS.ERROR: Sorry, I couldn't generate a response right now. Please try again.

SAVE.ERROR: Failed to save AI Assistant settings

LIST.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create your first AI agent to get started.

ITEM.DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete this agent? This action cannot be undone.

VOICE_AI.DESCRIPTION: Configure the LiveKit voice AI MVP and run browser-based test calls before connecting a phone provider.

SETUP.TITLE: Voice setup
SETUP.DESCRIPTION: Choose an API inbox, voice agent, fallback team, and recording behavior.
SETUP.RECORDING_HELP: Store call recordings when LiveKit recording is enabled.
SETUP.NO_API_INBOX: Create an API inbox before testing voice AI.
SETUP.SAVE_ERROR: Failed to save Voice AI settings.
SETUP.LOAD_ERROR: Failed to load Voice AI settings.

USAGE.TITLE: Voice AI usage
USAGE.HELP: Monthly voice minute usage for this account. Sandbox test calls are excluded.
USAGE.DISABLED_HELP: Voice AI is disabled by your administrator.

AGENTS.TITLE: Voice agents
AGENTS.LIST_HELP: Create agents and assign inboxes they can answer.
AGENTS.EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Configure the greeting, prompt, and tools used during calls. Runtime settings are managed by your administrator.
AGENTS.NAME: Name
AGENTS.ENABLED_HELP: Only enabled voice agents can answer calls.
AGENTS.DISABLED_BY_ADMIN: Voice AI is disabled by your administrator.
AGENTS.IKAS_READY: Ikas is connected and the storefront catalog is synced.
AGENTS.IKAS_CATALOG_NOT_SYNCED: Ikas is connected, but the storefront catalog is not synced yet.
AGENTS.IKAS_NOT_CONNECTED: Ikas is not connected for this account.

ASSIGNMENTS.TITLE: Inbox assignments
ASSIGNMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Choose which API inboxes this voice agent can answer. Move an inbox here when this agent should handle that test or future voice route.
ASSIGNMENTS.ASSIGNED_TO: Currently assigned to {agent}; saving will move it here.

TEST.TITLE: Sandbox test call
TEST.DESCRIPTION: Start a browser-only call using a saved voice-agent inbox assignment.
TEST.NO_ASSIGNED_INBOX: Assign an API inbox to this voice agent before starting a sandbox test call.

TRANSCRIPT.TITLE: Transcript
TRANSCRIPT.DESCRIPTION: Live speech turns and AI tool calls appear here during sandbox tests.
TRANSCRIPT.EMPTY: Transcript segments and tool calls will appear here after the voice agent posts them.
